findings.title: A/HEAVY — a present key with value undefined reads clean
findings.body: N7 says only an absent `task_notification` key reads clean, but the prescribed `!== undefined` check returns false when the key is present with value `undefined`. The current producer writes only `true`; the failure arises if a malformed or version-skewed in-memory extract supplies that value. The ledger could then accept a `false` declaration for a notification-bearing session. AC5 tests other malformed values but misses this one.
findings.recommendation: Check key presence with `Object.hasOwn(extract, 'task_notification')` and add `undefined` to AC5’s malformed-value cases.

next_steps: Correct N7 and rerun the ledger acceptance test and RED proofs.
